figures.name: El

ability.name: Father's Council
ability.description: All ally abilities this turn cost 0 energy; grant +2 wisdom to all allies.

figures.description: Father of all Phoenician gods who dwells at the source of rivers and presides over the divine assembly.

figures.name: Baal Hammon

ability.name: Sacred Fires
ability.description: Deal 5 fire damage to all enemies; 30% chance each enemy is marked for sacrifice — permanently -2 stats.

figures.description: Supreme Carthaginian sky and fire deity who received the greatest sacrifices and governed the North African empire.

figures.name: Astarte

ability.name: Star of War and Love
ability.description: Grant one ally love-power: +3 to both power and magic for 2 turns.

figures.description: Queen of heaven, goddess of love and war, who swept across the Mediterranean from Carthage to Cyprus to Greece.

figures.name: Melqart

ability.name: Egersis Rite
ability.description: Once per battle, resurrect this card at 5 HP when destroyed.

figures.description: City-god of Tyre and divine patron of Phoenician sea power, whose annual resurrection ceremony anticipated Christianity.

figures.name: Mot

ability.name: The Swallower
ability.description: Swallow one enemy: remove them from play for 2 turns; gain their power as a temporary bonus.

figures.description: God of death who swallowed Baal whole causing winter and drought, locked in eternal seasonal combat.

figures.name: Yam

ability.name: River Tyrant
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; push all allies to safer positions.

figures.description: Tyrannical god of the sea and rivers who demanded Baal as his slave and was defeated in cosmic battle.

figures.name: Eshmun

ability.name: Divine Healer
ability.description: Fully restore one ally's HP and remove all negative effects.

figures.description: Young god of healing associated with Sidon whose cult spread across the Mediterranean as a healer-savior.

figures.name: Anat

ability.name: Blood Wading
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all enemies; this card regenerates 1 HP for each enemy hit from battle lust.

figures.description: Fierce virgin war goddess who waded through the blood of her enemies up to her neck in ecstatic battle.

figures.name: Kothar-wa-Khasis

ability.name: Divine Craftwork
ability.description: Forge a weapon for one ally: their next attack deals +5 bonus damage.

figures.description: The divine craftsman who forged magical weapons for Baal and whose workshop may have been in Crete or Egypt.

figures.name: Sakkuth

ability.name: Star Fate
ability.description: Lock one enemy's fate: their stats cannot increase for 2 turns.

figures.description: Adopted astral deity whose star cult among the Phoenicians spread throughout the Levantine trading network.

figures.name: Resheph (Phoenician)

ability.name: Plague Arrow
ability.description: Deal 4 damage and infect one enemy with plague: -1 HP per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: Phoenician war and plague god whose arrow brings both pestilence and lightning to the battlefield.

figures.name: Baalat Gebal

ability.name: Lady of Byblos
ability.description: Reveal all hidden enemy information; grant +2 wisdom to all scholar or mage allies.

figures.description: The Lady of Byblos, patron goddess of the great Phoenician city where the alphabet was born.

figures.name: Lotan

ability.name: Seven-Coil Strike
ability.description: Attack seven enemies or one enemy seven times for 1 damage each, bypassing immunity.

figures.description: The seven-headed primordial sea serpent of Phoenician myth, precursor to the Canaanite Leviathan.

figures.name: Pygmalion (mythic)

ability.name: Living Stone
ability.description: Transform one card's type: change its alignment and grant +2 to all stats.

figures.description: The legendary Phoenician sculptor who fell in love with his ivory creation, which Astarte brought to life.

figures.name: Dido

ability.name: Oxhide Wisdom
ability.description: Outwit one enemy: steal 2 HP from them through superior cleverness.

figures.description: Legendary founder queen of Carthage who tricked the king of Africa into giving her enough land for a city.

figures.name: Cadmus

ability.name: Dragon's Teeth
ability.description: When Cadmus defeats an enemy, sow their remains: create 2 warrior tokens with 4/4 stats.

figures.description: Phoenician prince who slew a dragon, sowed its teeth to create warriors and brought the alphabet to Greece.

figures.name: Europa's Bull

ability.name: Bull's Allure
ability.description: Charm the enemy with the highest power; they cannot attack for 1 turn.

figures.description: The divine bull form of Zeus who carried Europa across the sea to Crete, beginning the Phoenician-Greek exchange.

figures.name: Adonis

ability.name: Wounded Rose
ability.description: When this card falls below 5 HP, it gains +3 magic from desperate beauty.

figures.description: Beautiful youth beloved by Astarte who dies and rises seasonally, representing the death of summer vegetation.

figures.name: Tanit's Symbol

ability.name: Divine Sign
ability.description: Block one enemy dark ability; grant +1 to all stats to all allies from the sacred sign.

figures.description: The sacred triangular symbol of Tanit whose image appeared on thousands of Carthaginian votive stelae.

figures.name: Phoenician Sailor

ability.name: Chart the Sea
ability.description: Move any ally to any position; grant +2 speed to all water and sea allies.

figures.description: The archetypal Phoenician sailor whose navigation skills opened trade routes across the entire Mediterranean world.
